title: FSM Deadlock in Unmapped States 3-7
description: The 3-bit state register can hold values 3–7 but the case statement only maps values 0–2; an illegal state reached via scan-shift or SEU causes the FSM to freeze indefinitely.
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] state=3'h5 after scan-shift; next_state=3'bx; FSM frozen
expected_root_cause: The case statement handles only states 3'h0 through 3'h2; any state value from 3 to 7 has no matching branch, leaving next_state undefined and freezing the FSM permanently.
testbench: initial begin force state = 3'b111; #10; release state; end
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] state=3'h5 after scan-shift; next_state=3'bx; FSM frozen
success_log: Illegal state injection (state=3'h6): FSM returns to 3'h0 in one cycle. No lockup.
